items.information:
Tato soutěž má pouze kategorii **3x3x3 Fewest Moves**! V ostatních běžnějších kategoriích budete moci soutěžit v září na [Czech Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CzechChampionship2025). 

The only event at this competition is **3x3x3 Fewest Moves**! You can compete in all the other events at [Czech Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CzechChampionship2025) in September.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA5NzI4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a80a66a118ed14a0308a2a7bb7832243c539e8b6/1000277037.png)

**Español**
Es muy importante prestar atención a posibles correos de parte de la organización en los días próximos al torneo. Se estará proporcionando una invitación a un grupo de WhatsApp para coordinaciones urgentes durante el torneo, y también información útil para competidores nuevos. Si alguien no tiene acceso al correo asociado a su cuenta en la WCA, deje una dirección de correo válida en la caja de comentarios al registrarse.

**English**
It's important to check your email as the competition approaches. An invite to a WhatsApp group for day-of coordination will be sent, as well as useful information for new competitors. If you do not have access to your WCA email account, please leave your new email address in the comments box during registration.

items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2025
items.information:
Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2025! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)".

-----

Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2025!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)".

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information:
# West Coast Cubing welcomes you to Las Vegas for Western Championship 2025!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODU4NzksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--0ca43cca8d2fb3caa9578fb8c494c9ed9e1e7a9f/1000018351.png)

### **Please visit the [Key Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2025#58976-key-information) tab for an overview of everything Western Champs 2025!**

The highest placing resident of California, Nevada, or Hawaii in each event at this competition will be recognized as the Western Champion! Check out the Western Championship Eligibility tab for more information.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2025#43185-new-competitor-information-and-faq) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized by [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and supported by our [sponsors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WesternChampionship2025#43187-sponsors-and-partners).
